_comment: Per-version verdict on whether a repo migration file with NO history row actually ran.
A ledger row is NEVER emitted from a guess: reconcile.mjs emits `mark-as-applied` SQL
only for versions listed here with verdict APPLIED, and quotes the evidence string.
OPS45's rule stands - writing fake history is worse than having none.
Probes recorded by DB22, 2026-08-03, all reads against production.
Re-probe before acting: an ABSENT object can become PRESENT and a verdict can rot.
